notes: Edit an INACTIVE theme (e.g. twentynineteen/404.php) so you don't break the live site. The file must stay syntactically valid PHP or the editor refuses to save.

Upgrade the webshell to an interactive reverse shell.

name: WordPress - Theme Editor Webshell (RCE)
description: With admin access, edit an inactive theme's PHP file (e.g. 404.php) via Appearance > Theme Editor to add a PHP system() call, then invoke it for command execution.

defense.why_it_works: WordPress's theme editor allows authenticated admin users to edit PHP template files directly through the web UI. Inserting a PHP webshell into any theme file (e.g., 404.php) creates a persistent backdoor executed on each HTTP request to that template.
defense.prerequisites: Valid WordPress admin credentials. Theme editing not disabled. write permission on theme files for www-data.
defense.impact: PHP webshell execution as the web server user. Leads to full server compromise, lateral movement to database, and persistent backdoor installation.
defense.detection: WordPress audit log showing theme file edit. File integrity alert on theme directory (WordFence). Outbound connections from web server process. New system()/exec() calls in theme PHP files.
defense.artifacts: WordPress audit log (theme file modification) | File system change: modified PHP in /wp-content/themes/ | Web server access log (GET to theme file with cmd param) | WordFence file change alert
defense.prevention: Disable file editing: define('DISALLOW_FILE_EDIT', true) in wp-config.php. Apply least privilege — web server user should not write to theme directories. Use read-only filesystem mounts in containers.
defense.misconfiguration: WordPress admin panel file editor enabled. www-data has write access to /wp-content/themes/. No filesystem integrity monitoring.
defense.vulnerable_config:
# wp-config.php default
# File editor NOT disabled
# /wp-content/themes/ writable by www-data
defense.evasion: Edit a less-visited file (404.php, footer.php). Use base64-encoded PHP to evade content scanners.
